title: UN Federal Resolution on Eritrea

title: British Administration Winds Down
reason: British authorities officially relinquished control on September 15, 1952 per the federation act, with the wind-down process beginning after the 1950 resolution. Core claim correct though the actual transfer was 1952.

reason: Well-documented split between Unionist Party and Independence Bloc during transition period. No specific source dispute.

reason: UN commissioner oversaw drafting of the Eritrean constitution, adopted by assembly July 10, 1952 and ratified August 11, 1952. The 1951 drafting process is well-documented.

reason: Elections held in 1952 (not 1951) per Wikipedia, which notes the elections 'gave the Unionist Party the largest number of seats.' Year is slightly off — elections were in 1952.

reason: British authorities relinquished control September 15, 1952. Federation formally established September 1952. Date confirmed.
